findings.closed_in: Normal non-admin PowerShell execution path before v1.45
findings.machine_check: Before each future Runtime attempt, require IsTokenRestricted=False and read-only effective child-create access to frozen ExecutionRoot plus required Replay access; prohibit Gate Q workspace-write Codex profile for Runtime.
findings.invariant: Runtime executor must have effective child-create access to C:\GateQ\v1.42\ExecutionRoot and controller-required write access to C:\GateQ\v1.42\Replay without broadening the frozen ACL contract.
findings.root_cause: Codex workspace-write restricted token / sandbox writable-root mechanism. Dedicated writable-root profile added sandbox ACEs and was rejected for Runtime because it changed the frozen DACL. Normal non-admin PowerShell restored 3-ACE DACL and read-only effective access ALLOW.

FileSecurity) in production code; reflection must resolve the replacement create-time ACL API; actual production helper must pass PowerShell 7.6.6 temp-only CreateNew/FileSecurity/WriteThrough/duplicate-fail/cleanup validation.
